criterion_bindings.exemption: Policy-only planning authority under CD-0213 D1. The CON-801 deletion slices remove the Concord planning write routes and carry their runtime evidence.
Process-authority assignment for public merge evidence. Repository review and CI retain their existing verification contracts.
Policy-only preservation of branch and worktree isolation. Existing worktree contracts and tests own runtime verification.
Policy-only requirement for explicit law amendment. Knowledge closure and law-relation checks validate declared records.
The pull-request link check owns this criterion and runs per pull request, not as a repository test.
This contract preserves durable workflow authority. Generated agent contracts and store workflow tests own its runtime evidence.
The predecessor-independence boundary is unchanged and has its own repository check.
Policy-only foreign-Product route under CD-0213 D6. Concord has no write path for it, so no Concord runtime evidence applies.
Policy-only outside-work boundary under CD-0122 D1. Host permissions remain authoritative.
Policy-only defect-repair application under CD-0122 D2. Repository isolation and public review evidence remain required.
Policy-only storage prohibition under CD-0213 D6. The store refuses an in-repository database path structurally.

summary: Assigns planning to Linear through the Linear MCP server, keeps managed workflow, review, merge, isolation, and law authority in their existing owners, and preserves the outside-work and defect-repair boundaries.
title: managed development authority
